title: 采购价格与合同、历史价格比较
context: 采购人员检查实际采购价是否偏离合同。
requirements: 2025年非取消采购行；比较合同单价、成交价及同供应商同商品上一采购行的实际单价；上一行按订单日期、行编号；输出合同差价及较上一单变动率。
commonError: 简单比较未经加权的供应商总价可能混入不同商品。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,product_id,unit_price_cents,contract_cents,unit_price_cents-contract_cents contract_variance_cents,previous_cents,ROUND(100.0*(unit_price_cents-previous_cents)/NULLIF(previous_cents,0),2) change_pct FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY po_item_id
